title: Light-hearted Hindi Couplets
description: Original, family-friendly couplets about everyday life, learning, and laughter.

seo.title: Light-hearted Hindi Couplets
seo.description: Original Hindi couplets about everyday life and simple lessons.
seo.ogDescription: Family-friendly original Hindi humour in short couplets.
seo.twitterDescription: Short, original Hindi couplets about everyday life.

jokes:
1. The morning sun peeked in and said, "Rise and shine!"
My pillow replied, "Give us just five more minutes."

2. My tea asked why I was late.
I said I had a long meeting with my dreams.

3. A book said, "Open me and learn something new."
Sleep said, "I have a lesson for you too."

4. I packed an umbrella for the rain,
then left it at home and got a fresh new hairstyle.

5. A little patience goes a long way,
especially when the kettle is slow today.

6. My wallet felt brave until the bill arrived;
then even the coins went quiet.

jokes: Teacher: Why is your homework blank? Student: I did not want to spoil the clean page.
Teacher: What travels fastest? Student: The bell when class ends.
Teacher: Why are you looking at the clock? Student: I am making sure it is still working.
Teacher: What is the capital of France? Student: The letter F, before you say Paris.
Teacher: What did you learn today? Student: That tomorrow is another school day.

title: Shayari Pe Shayari
description: Anand lijiye aur dijiye shayari kaaa.....
jokes:
1.Sitaaron mein aap, hawaaon mein aap,
Fizaon mein aap, baharon mein aap,
Dhoop mein aap, chhaon mein aap,
Sach hi suna hai ki…
Buri aatmaon ka koi thikaana nahi hota.

2.Arz kiya hai…
Tere chehre par udaasi, aankhon mein nami hai,
Tere chehre par udaasi, aankhon mein nami hai,
Tata Namak istemaal karo,
Kyonki tum mein iodine ki kami hai.

3.Tere gham mein tadap kar mar jaayenge,
Mar gaye to tera naam le jaayenge,
Rishwat dekar tujhe bhi bulaayenge,
Tum upar aaoge to saath baithkar Kurkure khaayenge.

4.Zindagi mein sada muskuraate raho,
Faasle kam karo, dil se dil milaate raho,
Dard kaisa bhi ho, koi gham na karo,
Iodex kharido aur lagaate raho.

5.Dosto, hum unhein mud-mud kar dekhte rahe,
Aur wo humein mud-mud kar dekhte rahe,
Wo humein, hum unhein; wo humein, hum unhein,
Kyonki pareeksha mein na unhein kuch aata tha, na humein.

title: Pati-Patni Jokes
description: Anand lijiye aur hansiye pati-patni ke mazedaar chutkulon ke saath...

seo.title: Pati Patni Jokes
seo.description: Pati Patni ke mazedaar aur funny chutkule.

jokes:
1.Biwi: Tum cigarette peena kab chhodoge?
Pati: Usi din jab tum bolna chhodogi!

2.Pati: Main tumhare bina nahi reh sakta!
Patni: Oh, kitna pyaar hai mujhse!
Pati: Nahi, main khana banana nahi jaanta!

3.Pati: Agar main mar jaaun to tum kya karogi?
Patni: Bank balance check karungi!!

4.Pati: Maine suna hai shaadi ke baad aadmi ki umar kam ho jaati hai.
Patni: Haan, main bhi tumhein tadap-tadap ke jeene nahi doongi!

5.Patni: Tum mujhse pyaar karte ho?
Pati: Haan, utna jitna tum mujhse ladti ho!

6.Pati ne pyaar se kaha: Kaash tum shakkar hoti, kabhi to meetha bolti...
Patni: Kaash tum adrak hote, kasam se ji bhar ke koot ti!

7.Patni: Mujhe shopping karne le chalo!
Pati: Tumne pichhle hafte hi to ki thi!
Patni: Ab yaadein taaza karne ke liye jaana hai!

8.Pati: Mujhe tumhare haath ka khana bahut pasand hai.
Patni: Sach?
Pati: Haan, isliye main bahar khata hoon taaki tumhari mehnat barbaad na ho!

9.Pati: Main aaj bahut khush hoon!
Patni: Kyun?
Pati: Tumhara munh aadhe ghante se band tha!

10.Pati (sochte hue): Shaadi ke baad zindagi hi badal gayi.
Patni: Kya badal gaya?
Pati: Pehle doston ke saath party, ab tumhare saath TV ke saamne serial!

11.Patni ne dinner mein pati ki pasand ki sabzi banayi.
Pati: Aaj khana bahut achha tha!
Patni: Mujhe pata tha tumhein baingan pasand hai.
Pati: Mujhe to bilkul pasand nahi!
Patni: Phir kyun tareef?
Pati: Taaki kal bhi khana mile!
12.Patni: Aap mujhe rani kyun bol
